headline: Main Fronts Seethe as Posts Change Hands
war_summary: The latest returns show the struggle narrowing around several unsettled sectors, with some changes since the previous edition. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the chief storm centre: 57 strategic-base events were recorded in the past day, five in the latest two hours, and the ledger stands at six Warden and three Colonial bases; casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. CallahansPassageHex has quickened to 31 daily events and six recently, holding eight Warden and two Colonial bases. StlicanShelfHex has reached 18 daily events, though only three in the latest two hours, with four Warden and five Colonial bases. MooringCountyHex is also active at 13 daily events and three recent, its count eleven Warden to one Colonial. FishermansRowHex retains seven Colonial and two Warden bases after 27 daily events, but its latest two-hour period is quiet and activity has cooled sharply. LinnMercyHex has newly entered the movement ledger with three events at Rotdust, while StemaLandingHex, formerly active, shows no event in the latest two hours. These sectors offer the clearest records for judging likely strategic-base movement over the next day.
